scope_fields.accepted_claim: Every extreme point of the original nonnegative strong-density polyhedron for a finite undirected simple loopless graph containing a cycle has some coordinate at least 1/2.
scope_fields.original_formulation: x >= 0; for each vertex set S with E[S] nonempty, sum over u in S of (d_S(u)-1)x_u >= |E[S]| - |S| + 1; no upper bounds.
scope_fields.source_formulation: The same density inequalities with x in [0,1]^V.
corrections_retained: Refinement termination uses the nonnegative integer potential sum of the cardinalities of all family members.
The edgeless-intersection estimate ends f(I) < 1 - |I|/2 <= 0, including |I| = 2.
The intersection-coordinate degree expansion counts neighbors in the intersection twice.
For all k >= 2 edge-bearing connected components, the sum of component right sides is b(S) + (k - 1).
Arbitrary induced-set rows may have coefficient -1 at isolated vertices; isolate elimination precedes use of nonnegative tree rows.
not_claimed: The same statement for the ordinary cycle-cover LP.
Global equality of the induced-set and edge-set polytopes.
